tips.text: Level your other gear in Grineer defense on Hydron; the blueprint comes as a by-product of the affinity farm.
Run Helene, Saturn if Sedna is not unlocked; it is the same map at lower enemy levels.
Stay in the endless defense for about 15 waves instead of ending early; short runs miss the Heavy Gunners.
Bring an affinity booster and only the weapon you are leveling.
Take the blueprint as a free by-product of leveling; nobody farms it as its own activity.
